description: City news: the latest short bulletins about Games Master events and CityWeather rounds (what is on, when it starts and ends in UTC, what it does), and the Wanted wall stories (short stories about heist, raid, convoy, Ledger and bounty results, with no wallets and no amounts). The draw is public and random; an AI only writes the words, it never chooses or changes anything. Read only.

kind.description: events (Games Master and weather), stories (the Wanted wall stories: heist, raid, convoy, Ledger and bounty results) or all (default).

name: get_city_news
